Complete sources, this protocol, native build provenance and preflight review committed before any wiring or benchmark construction. All development/reserved temporal windows must reproduce the sealed geometry using the new source-membership raster before wiring. Wiring must pass and be committed before benchmarking.
actions: For worker i in0..15 and decision step in0..2047, action=(step//4+i)%18. Same18000+i seeds in both backends for a paired engineering comparison; game/seed pairs are distinct from all prior captures. No RAM or perception score selects actions. Every128decisions run action versusNOOP for4real frames each, paying both restores and all truncated branches.
wiring: Per game,18176: two engines with episode_limit300 for128decisions, one with its oracle removed; RGB/boxes/C and ledgers must agree.18177: reference subject and independent cold witness, episode_limit509,129decisions, ordinary RGB and exact threeRAM history must agree across a terminal branch and next cold.18178: one reference worker, closed RPC attempts and one ordinary decision. motion: Source-frame movement history uses ordinary acted images only. Frame0 supplies pooled geometry but the first cold0-to1 transition is outside movement eligibility. Static pills never become moving through occlusion; a pooled component inherits eligibility from any moving source member. Render slots/pieces are not certified physical identities. ROI selection uses box centers, and precision includes all visible categories, including pills.
failure: A decoder/scorer error leaves any executed frame charged, poisons the trajectory and forbids all later actions in the pool. Reports and close remain available where transport permits. Durable attempts precede constructors; outputs are never overwritten. No benchmark or calibration criterion is repaired using the reserved result.
comparison: Run NumPy then native once for each game. Every worker report must be exactly equal, including an ordered SHA256 digest of every ordinary RGB/box output and both branch RGB/box outputs. The digest includes phase tags, array dtypes, shapes and contiguous bytes. Retain a failed equivalence instead of selecting another run. Recheck the initially verified geometry, wiring, NumPy pair and source/build proofs after the paid work. Include emulator/IPC/reference/scorer/digest/branches/restores in work time, startup separately. Numerator is ordinary agent decisions; report raw emulated frames and charged frames separately. No speedup claim from one sequential comparison under concurrent ARC3 load.
scope: Engineering diagnostics, not gate0 or learning. Reference metrics remain conditional on the corrected source-frame RAM judge, which has no new independent raw validation. A reference recall miss stays visible and requires diagnosis; it is not automatically a RAM defect. Proposed gate throughput thresholds are not lowered by this protocol.
